runtime.execution: Rust Tokio CLI/client and separate server session actors; native provider SDK; MCP server TaskManager owns local/SSH/background child processes; autopilot scheduler/gateway.
runtime.service_boundary: Consumes provider HTTP/MCP/SSH/API; owns checkpoints/session services, schedule DB, task manager and optional sandbox containers. Shared persistent sandbox server-owned, ephemeral session-owned.

summary: Stakpak is a DevOps-oriented native agent with interactive/async CLI, server run coordination, local/remote tracked process tasks, optional child agents, skills/docs and standing autopilot schedules.

inspection.scope: Traced both distinct CLI AgentClient completion/tool continuation and server agent-core actor -> native provider -> MCP result -> checkpoint/event continuation; inspected task lifecycle, subagent resume, router, scheduler reload, request trimming and source oracles.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. References not executed. Warden network enforcement/secret substitution full implementation and other provider protocols not audited; no full security assurance inferred. Gateway dispatcher state read at ownership boundary, not complete channel transport conformance. Cancellation/no-progress risks are source inferences, not reproduced runtime faults.

actions.name: view, str_replace, create, remove
actions.input: local or SSH path; line range/grep/glob/tree; exact old/new; file text; recursive; optional SSH auth
actions.output: text/tree/search max300 lines; mutation/errors and selected backup paths
actions.lifecycle: awaited; tools route local or SSH connection
actions.authority: profile/tool approval and sandbox/host boundary; uses operator OS/SSH authority

actions.name: run_command, run_remote_command
actions.lifecycle: awaited synchronous service execution with optional timeout
actions.authority: approval/profile policy; local host or SSH connection

actions.name: run_command_task, run_remote_command_task
actions.lifecycle: returns background task after bounded start check; manager owns process/remote connection
actions.authority: same tool policy; global manager not session-isolated

actions.name: get_all_tasks, get_task_details, wait_for_tasks, cancel_task
actions.input: task_id or whitespace task_ids; wait timeout
actions.output: status/output/duration/pause info; wait error or cancel result
actions.lifecycle: inspection/wait/terminate; cancelled task removed; no persisted process identity across manager death
actions.authority: task ID possession plus tool access; no session guard traced

actions.name: dynamic_subagent_task, resume_subagent_task
actions.output: background child task identity; paused checkpoint details; resumed new CLI invocation
actions.lifecycle: asynchronous subprocess; inspect/wait/cancel by task tools; checkpoint resume after paused/completed status
actions.authority: parent chooses child model/tools and approval input; launches same executable, not refit

actions.name: search_docs, load_skill
actions.output: up to five docs results; local skill body/path or remote rulebook text
actions.lifecycle: awaited service/file read; load_skill local path restricted to configured directories
actions.authority: profile tools plus optional API; not model-owned persistent evidence DB

actions.name: generate_password, view_web_page
actions.output: generated password; converted webpage text or error
actions.authority: tools/profile; output password itself returned as text

actions.name: ask_user
actions.output: interactive answer in TUI; INTERACTIVE_REQUIRED at actual server handler
actions.lifecycle: requires interactive path, cannot be assumed available to autopilot/headless

actions.name: slack_read_messages, slack_read_replies, slack_send_message
actions.lifecycle: awaited external transport via configured AgentProvider
actions.authority: optional Slack family/profile and credentials; no inherent model peer routing

actions.name: run_agent; AgentCommand Steering, FollowUp, SwitchModel, Cancel, ResolveTool(s)
actions.input: session/run identity; prompt, model or tool call decision
actions.lifecycle: steer between provider/tool phases, skip pending calls with result placeholders; follow-up after finish; no immediate cancellation during inference/approval wait
actions.authority: host/session API; stale run ID rejected

actions.name: CLI -a pause/resume checkpoints; interactive session/model/profile switching
actions.lifecycle: CLI distinct pipeline; interactive stream cancellation select; profile outer loop restarts session services

actions.name: autopilot schedule add/remove/enable/disable; cron/check scripts
actions.lifecycle: long-lived scheduler reconciles changed config; skip prior running schedule; errors can bypass singleton check
actions.authority: operator can configure; model can use shell as composition, no native workflow code interpreter

actions.name: SSE event replay; latest/checkpoint messages API
actions.input: session and event cursor or saved checkpoint identity
actions.output: typed event envelopes, replay or gap requiring snapshot refresh; saved messages
actions.lifecycle: bounded in-memory replay; latest envelope rename-replaced
actions.authority: server API; no permanent complete event audit

actions.name: AgentHook / HookContext lifecycle
actions.input: compiled async callback around inference/tool/request and state
actions.output: error/Continue/Skip/Abort; mutable CLI inference context; server hook snapshots
actions.lifecycle: host-selected hooks; server AgentHook message slice is immutable
actions.authority: program author; no runtime model-owned turn replacement

filesystem.detail: Native local/SSH view/grep/tree/str_replace/create/remove; bounded views and backup machinery. External tools selected by router/profile.

processes.detail: Sync/background local+SSH command tasks with IDs/status/output/wait/cancel, null stdin/process groups; manager owns/terminates work.

code_actions.detail: Shell tasks can run ordinary programs, subprocess subagents and check scripts; no persistent general-purpose kernel/code-action interpreter traced.

persistent_kernel.detail: Not established in CLI/server loops or native MCP catalog; standing shell task is not a programmable interpreter namespace.

standing_database.detail: Session/checkpoint/scheduler DB state internal; README memory claim does not establish model standing DB and search_memory tool is commented out.

workflow_programming.detail: Cron/check/prompt/profile workflows, background coordination and subprocess child checkpoint resume; hook primitives host compiled. No model-native program orchestration interpreter.

multi_model.detail: Different per-profile/server models and explicit child model resolution; server SwitchModel applies later request boundary.

live_collaboration.detail: Child task/resume plus optional Slack read/send and gateway conversations can compose interaction; no model peer room/identity/broadcast/receipt protocol established.

concurrent_work.detail: Independent session actors, background process/subagent tasks and scheduled runs; one active run per session with stale-ID guards.

steering_interrupt.detail: Server steering skips unstarted calls with paired placeholders; follow-up after finish; MCP calls cancel-select. Inference/retry sleep/approval recv do not promptly observe flipped cancellation token. Interactive CLI has separate stream cancel select.

turn_redefinition.detail: Compiled lifecycle hooks and configurable profiles/tool approval/turn count; request/action/continuation structure stays compiled. CLI mutable context hook broader than immutable server hook.

compaction.detail: Budget reducer trims request copies with stable metadata boundary and pairing cleanup; server overflow compactor is passthrough and repeats unchanged context with decremented turn count (source-inferred no-progress risk).

context_repair.detail: Original message vectors remain in checkpoint while request reducer trims copies; CLI resumes selected saved checkpoint. No model selective history-repair action or untrim override traced.

original_audit.detail: Latest snapshots and bounded in-memory event ring; core text/reasoning deltas synthesized after full generate, nontext tool output omitted. Raw provider request/delta/everything journal not established.

audit_query.detail: Cursor replay with explicit gap and snapshot/messages API plus scheduler histories/checkpoints; incomplete original audit and ring lost on server death.

hot_change.detail: Scheduler config mtime/DB signal reconciliation preserves old state on parse/load error, rejects DB-path changes; CLI model changes/profile restart. No universal settled workflow activation transaction.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Versioned latest checkpoint and child pause/resume persist context; server/manager work ownership and kill-on-drop require composition for refit. No outpost/quiescence executable handoff traced.

remote_services.detail: Provider HTTP/MCP/SSH/docs/rulebook/optional Slack gateway services; session host may share persistent sandbox at server scope.

self_improvement.detail: File/program/skill editing is available; measured model-governed harness change/rebuild/evaluation loop not established in inspected paths.

complaints.detail: RunError and external notifications exist; model grievance with state capture and external complaint record not established.

authority.detail: ToolApprovalPolicy per profile/server; allowlist/autopilot controls, run-ID validation and optional shared/ephemeral sandbox. Full Warden/secret security guarantee not audited in this study.

evaluation.detail: Read concurrency guard, budget sanitation, ring gap and schedule reload tests. Drop child-kill named test lacks post-drop process liveness oracle.

time_order.detail: UUID run/task IDs, request/turn counts, wall times, cron/durations and replay cursor; per-session counter allocated before ring lock is not a global durable causal order.

evidence.claim: Tokio native CLI entry.
Async CLI model request through AgentClient, accumulate usage and append assistant.
CLI pending-approval pause manifest/checkpoint and sequential MCP execution with hour timeout.
Interactive CLI streams AgentClient reply and races stream processing against cancellation; calls cancel_stream.
AgentClient hooks before/after request and creates saved session/checkpoint around completion.
Mutable CLI inference hook prepares input, local stakai chat/chat_stream dispatch and output hook.
Server creates command queue/cancellation handle and owned session task; marks finished afterward.
Session loads latest checkpoint; persistent sandbox shared at server scope or owned ephemeral container; host tools fallback explicit.
Server baseline/periodic/terminal checkpoints; actual run_agent wiring uses PassthroughCompactionEngine and BudgetAwareContextReducer.
Core drains steering/model switches at boundary, request-copy context reduction and awaited inference; context overflow invokes compactor.
Overflow compacts, subtracts turn count and restarts; retries sleep without cancellation select.
Full inference result emits text/reasoning pseudo-deltas then assistant and proposed tool events; these are not raw provider stream chunks.
Follow-up queue runs after no-tool completion; terminal messages/metadata returned.
Sequential approval/action cycle keeps call pairing, appends cancelled/skipped placeholders and drains steering between actions.
Approval wait blocks on command_rx.recv, with no cancellation-token select; commands include Steering, FollowUp, SwitchModel, Cancel.
Atomic one-active-run per session with Starting reservation and stale-start handling.
Commands/cancel validated by session/run ID; cancel_run only flips token.
MCP metadata carries session/run/call IDs; tool request races token with response and sends cancellation notification; nontext output omitted.
Native provider posts converted request for Responses or Chat Completions and parses response.
Local/remote/combined router assembly; subagent and Slack tool families conditionally enabled.
Synchronous local/SSH commands and local background task delegation into TaskManager.
SSH background command creates remote connection and starts tracked task.
Task list displays manager-global tasks and paused-task progress.
cancel_task and wait_for_tasks operate task IDs with terminal statuses and optional timeout.
get_task_details returns status/output/paused details for task ID.
Filesystem view/search/tree and exact string replace/create route local or SSH path; view capped 300 lines.
remove routes recursive/local/remote operations.
Password generation and HTTPS webpage fetch are actual tools.
ask_user advertised but stub errors in server/headless; TUI intercept is required.
Dynamic child tool resolves explicit/config/parent model and tools, launches CLI process as background task.
Resume child reads paused/completed task checkpoint, builds a new CLI invocation and passes tool decisions or input.
Task manager in-memory global HashMap and channels; no per-session task ownership field.
Cancel removes task, sends cancel, kills local process group and aborts handle.
Background subprocess uses null stdin/captured outputs and Unix own process group.
Handle Drop signals shutdown that terminates owned tasks, not checkpoint-preserving pause.
search_docs routed to AgentProvider, cap five, sanitize text.
search_memory implementation is commented out, despite approval/README memory mentions.
load_skill reads configured-directory local file or remote rulebook.
Budget reducer sanitizes pairing, trims assistant/tool text on request copy, persists monotonic trim boundary metadata; user/system preserved.
Passthrough compactor returns unchanged messages, equal whitespace-estimated counts and truncated false.
Latest checkpoint atomically rename-replaced, with versioned message/metadata envelope.
Server events kept bounded in-memory ring, per-session IDs/replay, explicit snapshot-required gap notices.
Hot schedule reload preserves current state on load errors, rejects DB-path change and reconciles future jobs.
Schedule singleton guard checks DB running state; DB check error proceeds anyway.
Operator schedule add/remove/enable/disable writes config and signals reload.
DM/group/thread routing selects one conversation routing key; not independent model peer collaboration.
Gateway active runs, pending input/approval and cursor maps are in-memory; crash recovery delegated to watch reconciler.
Optional native Slack read channel/thread and send actions through AgentProvider.
CLI hook lifecycle and Continue/Skip/Abort policy points; mutable HookContext is host program surface.
Concurrent start test asserts exactly one success and one already-running conflict.
Replay cursor and ring-overflow gap source oracles.
Drop test asserts manager exits; named child-kill test checks running before drop but has no post-drop liveness assertion.
Reload failure source oracle asserts false and unchanged registered schedule count.
Trimming oracle preserves user/system and expects some assistant/tool placeholder; no provider-token correctness proof.
Profile switch validates new config then sends shutdown/restarts outer session, not executable refit.

tests.oracle: Barrier two starts: exactly one success and one conflict; direct run-ID rejection tests. It does not prove cross-process coordination.
Sequential publications assert replay after cursor and ring-loss gap bounds; no restart durability or concurrent publisher ordering oracle.
Checks user/system preserved and assistant/tool placeholders, pairing and trim boundary stability using estimator; not provider tokenizer correctness.
Manager-exit flag checked; named child-kill test only asserts Running before drop then sleeps/cleans marker, no post-drop liveness assertion.
Injected config-read failure returns false and keeps registered count; runtime token and schedule reconciliation tests separate.

strengths: Run IDs and atomic Starting reservation make per-session ownership/races explicit.
Concrete process task IDs, remote SSH handling and paused child checkpoints are useful lifecycle precedents.
Request-copy trimming separates presentation budget from stored original message vector.
Bounded replay reports missing events instead of silently promising completeness.
Schedule reload rejects incompatible storage changes and retains prior config on load error.
limits: References not executed. Warden network enforcement/secret substitution full implementation and other provider protocols not audited; no full security assurance inferred. Gateway dispatcher state read at ownership boundary, not complete channel transport conformance. Cancellation/no-progress risks are source inferences, not reproduced runtime faults.
arconaut_questions: Should cancellation wake every awaited phase and require acknowledged quiescence rather than setting a token?
How should compaction prove progress before retry and preserve retrievable original material?
Which process/task manager belongs in shared fabric, and which client identity/lease guards access?
How should schedule activation coordinate ongoing workflows and model-selected runtime changes?
What permanent raw audit and grievance capture must be added beyond replay ring/checkpoints?
